snippet.title: SAMSON | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Samson is dropping on April 8, 2026 for $24,99. Get ready. 

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520
Wishlist on Epic Games Store now: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/samson-ab5af7

Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

SAMSON is developed and published by Liquid Swords.
